purpose: Document city-local registry evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-vector access review.
assessment: BMC documents city property-tax records and GIS-based survey, and BDA publishes land-use planning products. The official BhuNaksha map-backed selector returned only Puri, Nayagarh, and Rayagada, not Khordha. No plot-info endpoint or parcel geometry was queried.
registryAssessment: RegistryFound is based on local BMC property records and city planning services; it is not a claim that public cadastral polygons are available or that the WUP point is covered.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Odisha BhuNaksha plot-map UI with District, Tehsil, RI, Village and Sheet selectors; public selector request currently returned only three district choices, none Khordha.
Official Odisha Bhulekh Map View page links to the official BhuNaksha service and exposes village-map/plot-map entry points.
Bhubaneswar Municipal Corporation says property-tax records are being computerised and GIS maps are used for its city survey; this is local property-tax administration, not public parcel polygons.
Bhubaneswar Development Authority offers a land-use map for 205 villages and a clearly labeled draft GIS-based CDP plan; neither was treated as a cadastral vector layer.
ORSAC describes statewide georeferenced cadastral-level land-use maps; the portal is a state asset/planning system, not verified public parcel vectors for this city point.

searchQueries.query: Bhubaneswar official cadastral parcel map GIS land records Bhubaneswar Development Authority
searchQueries.result: The official BhuNaksha application is a village-level plot-map viewer. Its anonymous current selector returns map-backed district entries Puri, Nayagarh, and Rayagada; Khordha (Bhubaneswar) was absent. BDA’s official public pages link land-use maps and a draft CDP map, not parcel vectors.
searchQueries.method: Separate English search, official BDA/BMC pages, and public BhuNaksha selector/schema review.
